name: Lord of the World
desc: Benson's apocalyptic novel of 1907, set in a near-future world that has all but abandoned the faith: a charismatic humanist statesman, Julian Felsenburgh, unites the nations under the religion of Humanity while a priest, Percy Franklin, and a dwindling Church stand against him. In three books: the Advent, the Encounter, the Victory.
desc_pt: O romance apocalíptico de Benson (1907), ambientado num futuro próximo que quase abandonou a fé: um estadista humanista carismático, Julian Felsenburgh, une as nações sob a religião da Humanidade, enquanto um padre, Percy Franklin, e uma Igreja cada vez menor lhe resistem. Em três livros: o Advento, o Encontro, a Vitória.
edition: Lord of the World (London: Hutchinson, 1907), Project Gutenberg #14021, proofread.
srcnote: Book and chapter divisions as printed; the numbered sections inside chapters are kept as ## headings.
